payload.posture: Read Galatians 1:18–24 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states paul meets Cephas and James while Judea hears of change. Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days. So they glorified God in me. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
